learningObjectives: Explain the structure and purpose of an Express.js backend.
Create REST endpoints using HTTP methods and routes.
Understand how requests, responses, and middleware work together.

activities.title: Express Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore the main components of an Express application.

content.concept: Express organizes backend applications around routes, middleware, request handling, and responses.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: REST Method Match
activities.instruction: Match HTTP methods to their typical REST operations.

content.concept: REST APIs commonly use HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE to represent resource operations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Request Response Journey
activities.instruction: Arrange the path of a request through an Express server.

content.concept: An Express request can pass through middleware and route handlers before producing a response to the client.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: REST API Builder
activities.instruction: Build routes for a simple resource-based API.

content.concept: A REST API exposes resources through predictable routes, HTTP methods, request data, and structured responses.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
